run_train_net: run the detectron2 training script with a config file to train object detection models on GPU
run_train_net_eval_only: run the detectron2 training script in eval-only mode to evaluate a pre-trained model on a test dataset
build_evaluator: build an evaluator for a given dataset using the Trainer class and dataset metadata
test_with_TTA: test a detectron2 model with test-time augmentation enabled for improved inference accuracy
setup_config: setup detectron2 configuration by merging a config file with command-line arguments and freezing settings
